content:
The `internal/scheduler` package (the cron scheduler library) is only used in its own tests and examples — nothing in `server/` or elsewhere in the app actually registers a job with it. There's no database-cleanup job wired up anywhere in the codebase.

r03. Premise correction: there is no nightly database-cleanup job scheduled in this codebase. `internal/scheduler` (internal/scheduler/scheduler.go, README.md) is a general-purpose cron scheduler library, but a search across the repo for its `scheduler.New()`/`Register()` usage turns up matches only inside the package's own tests and examples (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go`, `internal/scheduler/doc.go`, `internal/scheduler/README.md`) — none in application code (`server/`, `store/`, etc.). There is also no symbol or reference matching "cleanup"/"vacuum"/"purge" tied to a database job with a cron schedule; the only cleanup-related code found (`store/cache/cache.go:200-253` `cleanupLoop`/`cleanup`/`cleanupOldest`) is an in-memory cache eviction loop, not a database job, and it isn't driven by the cron scheduler. So there's no cron time to report — no such job exists in the repo as indexed.
